covers: JSE session Friday 6 November 2026 to about 16:05 SAST, the US October jobs report (15:30 SAST) and markets to 16:19 SAST; US share indices are Thursday 5 November closes
headline: US added 165,000 jobs in October, well above the past year's average; Sappi (scanner SELL) extends its results-day fall to −15.9%, now below the R11.22 target
summary: On the JSE, Sappi fell 15.9% to R10.96 by 16:04 and Prosus (−4.1%), British American Tobacco (−4.2%) and Richemont (−3.8%) weighed, though the All Share (112,388) and Top 40 (104,334) are still 4.4% and 5.0% up on a week ago (LRC prices, 6 Nov 16:04–16:19 SAST). US payrolls rose by 165,000 in October against a 48,000 monthly average over the prior 12 months, with unemployment at 4.1% and August–September revised up by a combined 84,000 (BLS, 6 Nov). After the report the US 10-year yield was at 4.87% (4.84% Thursday), the rand at R16.58/$ (R16.50 this morning) and gold at $4,046, while Brent at $98.61 remains 16.2% down on the week.

items.title: US October payrolls +165,000; unemployment 4.1%
items.summary: Non-farm payrolls rose by 165,000 in October, higher than the average monthly gain of 48,000 over the prior 12 months. Unemployment was 4.1% (4.2% in September). Average hourly earnings rose 0.4% on the month to $38.00, and 3.1% on the year. August was revised to +186,000 (from +133,000) and September to +60,000 (from +29,000), together 84,000 higher than first reported. The Fed holds its next meeting on 9 December with its rate at 3.75–4.00%.
items.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation, released 6 Nov 2026 08:30 ET (15:30 SAST); LRC Market Dashboard (Fed rate, 28 Oct 2026)

items.title: Sappi −15.9% to R10.96, now 2.3% below the scanner target of R11.22
items.summary: Sappi was due to report Q4 and full-year results to September 2026 today. The share had already fallen 7.8% by mid-morning and was at R10.96 at 16:04, down 15.9% from Thursday's R13.03 close, and is now about 2.3% below the LRC Stock Scanner's blended target of R11.22 (rating SELL, unchanged by this desk). Sappi's investor pages still showed only Q3 results when checked this afternoon, so results figures are not yet published here.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance prices), 6 Nov 2026 16:04 SAST; Sappi investor pages, checked 6 Nov 2026
